name: Chicken Milanese & Italian Pizzeria Salad with Creamy Oregano Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place flour and bread crumbs onto two separate plates. Season each plate with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs.

Dredge chicken fillets in flour, shake off excess, then dip into the bowl with the egg. Let the egg drip off, then dredge the chicken fillets in the bread crumbs, pressing to adhere. Set aside on a plate.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Add chicken to the skillet; cook until it is cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side (working in batches if necessary). Once chicken is done, remove from skillet and place on a paper-towel lined plate.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together mayonnaise, vinegar, oil, and oregano.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup red wine vinegar
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice the bell peppers and add to the salad bowl.
Trim the ends of the cucumbers; halve lengthwise, then thinly slice into half-moons. Add cucumbers to the salad bowl.
Halve the olives lengthwise and add to the salad bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the chicken and salad between plates. Top with grated Parmesan and enjoy!
